batch: NTCore Filter Monitor current publisher-source recheck

sources.finding: The current official NTCore Download page still lists Filter Monitor among its utilities.

The product page lists version 1.1.0, says x86/x64, claims Windows support from Vista RTM through Windows 7 RTM and disclaims guarantees for future Windows because it relies on system internals. It says the driver is unsigned and requires booting with driver-signature enforcement disabled.
The official product-page Download link resolves to this ZIP URL. The web source reader returned Cache miss; archive bytes and members were not retrieved in this review.

scopeDisposition: Keep Filter Monitor in the selected publisher-list migration review; do not classify it as end-of-life or a license exclusion. Its publisher-documented OS limit and unsigned-driver boot requirement are explicit compatibility gates. No Windows 11 support or execution is claimed. Exact archive/member identity is needed for a pinned package staging candidate; if prepared, owner/version license review remains informational, not a migration gate.

estimates.adjustment: None; current-source recheck records a compatibility gate and closes no product or aggregate legacy outcome.
